description: Add HTTP API handlers for finding status management: PUT endpoint to set/update a finding status, and a GET endpoint to list findings with optional status filtering. Wire these into the server router.
steps: Add request/response types in internal/sbommon/handlers.go: updateFindingStatusRequest (Status string, Justification string, ExpiresAt *string), findingStatusResponse (ID, VersionID, VulnID, Purl, Status, Justification, UpdatedBy, UpdatedAt, ExpiresAt fields).

Implement HandleUpdateFindingStatus(store SBOMStore) http.HandlerFunc in internal/sbommon/handlers.go. It should: parse scanID from URL, look up the scan result to get version_id, verify ownership (scan->version->project->user chain), validate the request body (status must be one of the valid values, justification required for risk_accepted), call store.UpsertFindingStatus, and return the result. URL pattern: PUT /api/v1/sbom/scans/{scanID}/findings/{vulnID}/status with purl in the request body.

Implement HandleListFindingStatuses(store SBOMStore) http.HandlerFunc in internal/sbommon/handlers.go. It should: parse scanID from URL, verify ownership, accept optional ?status query param (comma-separated list of statuses to filter by), call store.ListFindingStatuses with the version_id, and return the list. URL pattern: GET /api/v1/sbom/scans/{scanID}/findings/statuses.

Register the new routes in internal/server/server.go under the existing /api/v1/sbom route group: r.Put("/scans/{scanID}/findings/{vulnID}/status", sbommon.HandleUpdateFindingStatus(s.sbomStore)), r.Get("/scans/{scanID}/findings/statuses", sbommon.HandleListFindingStatuses(s.sbomStore)).

Add unit tests in internal/sbommon/handlers_test.go for: TestHandleUpdateFindingStatus_Success, TestHandleUpdateFindingStatus_InvalidStatus, TestHandleUpdateFindingStatus_RiskAcceptedRequiresJustification, TestHandleUpdateFindingStatus_IDORProtection, TestHandleListFindingStatuses_Success, TestHandleListFindingStatuses_FilterByStatus.
acceptance_criteria: PUT /api/v1/sbom/scans/{scanID}/findings/{vulnID}/status endpoint handles status updates with proper validation
GET /api/v1/sbom/scans/{scanID}/findings/statuses endpoint returns finding statuses with optional filtering
IDOR protection: users cannot modify or view finding statuses for projects they do not own
Validation: invalid status values return 400, risk_accepted without justification returns 400
Routes are registered in the server router
All new handler unit tests pass
findings: All tests pass. Build succeeds. Routes registered alongside existing scan endpoints in server.go. Used strings import in test file for justification error message check.
